=== Possible James Glasgow, Charlestown postal addressee, 1775 ===
James Glasgow and Ezekiel Glasgow appear in the list of letters remaining in Charlestown’s General Post Office, dated 21 August 1775.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/605068969/ The South-Carolina and American General Gazette, 1775-08-25, p.1].</ref>

The list does not state James’s residence or age and proves no relationship to the co-listed Ezekiel.

This may concern [[Glasgow-804]]. Born 11 Nov 1735, Ayr, exact; died 19 May 1788, Newberry, South Carolina, exact. A James Glasgow documented in South Carolina and alive during 1775 is geographically and chronologically compatible with a Charleston addressee. No record connects him to this post-office entry. His exact 1788 death is a concrete conflict with identifying him as the James Glasgow listed in Edinburgh in December 1789.
